title: Independent replay of the S4 knot hardness
claim: Target: a separately written code path, written in the same session (V1 independence, not external review), confirms the finite claims of BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A, and a line-by-line audit of its written proof finds no gap. Diagrams: the alternating diagram of a plane graph G built from ports and corners alternates, has 1 + dim B(G) components, and has determinant equal to the spanning-tree count of G. Bicycle law: for G with every edge tripled, the number of S4 transposition colourings, enumerated by brute force from the Wirtinger presentation, equals the sum over vertex potentials phi: V -> Z3 of 2^(c(H_phi) + dim B(H_phi)), with dim B computed as the dimension of the intersection of the cycle and cut spaces. Links: with every edge subdivided first, the count equals 2^-n 4^m Z_Potts(G; 12, 1/2). Knots: substituting the gadget S(e,P(e,S(e,e))) and its odd parallel powers keeps the diagram a knot when the host's spanning-tree count is odd, the brute-force counts of the resulting knots equal the gadget prediction, and the Vandermonde interpolation over odd parallel powers recovers P(H, 12).
failure_conditions: A rebuilt diagram that does not alternate, or whose number of components or determinant disagrees with the graph.
A brute-force colouring count that differs from the bicycle-law sum, from 2^-n 4^m Z(G;12,1/2) on a subdivided graph, or from the gadget prediction on a substituted graph.
A substitution predicted to keep a knot that gives a link, or an interpolation that fails to recover P(H,12).
A gap in the written proof of BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A.
foundation_claim_scope: Replay of BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A on the tested diagrams and on its written argument, by a code path written in the same session that imports nothing from the producer's check (V1 independence; not external review). The cited theorems (Rosenstiehl-Read, Vertigan) are not re-proved. No P versus NP claim.

validation.status: checked: line-by-line audit of the written proof of BOUNDED-H1-20261025-001A (no gap found); check.py (standard library, about 9 minutes, imports nothing from the producer's check) rebuilds alternating diagrams from ports and corners and verifies on 19 plane graphs alternation, 1 + dim B components and determinant = spanning-tree count; brute-force S4 transposition colourings of the Wirtinger presentations (layered enumeration over pairings, then transpositions) equal the bicycle-law sum and the twelve-state sum on 16 tripled graphs, 2^-n 4^m Z(G;12,1/2) on 6 subdivided graphs with 1 + beta1 components, the gadget prediction on 4 gadget knots (up to 1,158,510 colourings); the gadget matrix is 68J + 32I - 8N; odd parallel powers give knots, even ones links; the Vandermonde solve recovers P(H,12) for K4, C5 and the diamond; three controls. Same-session V1 independence; no human or external review
